packageRules.description: Python stays below 3.15. PyYAML 6.0.3, the latest release, ships no cp315 wheel (yaml/pyyaml#981 and #994, open on 2026-11-01) and reaches the lock through uvicorn[standard] and pre-commit, while CI and the Docker build sync with --no-build, so every 3.15 bump fails Lint & Test and Build & scan. Remove this rule once PyYAML publishes cp315 wheels.
